1.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
1.descriptions:
Finish the process.
There are things you've been carrying for too long. Promises, thoughts, tasks...

2.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
2.descriptions:
Feel the boundaries.
Being kind doesn't mean being open to everything...

3.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
3.descriptions:
Break the pattern.
You've done this a hundred times. Out of habit. Out of inertia. According to someone else's script...

4.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
4.descriptions:
Feel my own rhythm.
You were not created to run at someone else's signal. Your rhythm is in silence, in breathing, in...

5.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
5.descriptions:
Accept uncertainty.
You are not obligated to know what comes next. Sometimes a new direction is born precisely in the fog...

6.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
6.descriptions:
Leave the past in the past.
You are no longer there. And even if thoughts return – it's just an echo...

7.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
7.descriptions:
Step out of the role.
You were who you needed to be for too long. Strong. Good. Indispensable...

8.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
8.descriptions:
Reclaim my voice.
You were silent for a long time. Perhaps out of caution, fear, or the habit of being convenient...

9.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
9.descriptions:
Experience life fully.
Not for survival. But for taste. For shades. For depth...

10.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
10.descriptions:
Take a breath out.
You are constantly tense and have forgotten what it's like to relax...

11.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
11.descriptions:
Choose a new step.
You are not obligated to go where you went yesterday. Even if everyone expects it...

12.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
12.descriptions:
Be honest with myself.
You can try to tell yourself the truth. The one that needs no explanation...

13.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
13.descriptions:
Understand what I want.
How much longer can you run without knowing where? And how often did the answer appear at the wrong time...

14.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
14.descriptions:
Change focus.
One turn of attention – and what seemed hopeless no longer weighs so heavily.

15.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
15.descriptions:
Acknowledge that I cannot.
This is not a defeat. It is maturity. Being honest with yourself: right now – I cannot...

16.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
16.descriptions:
Believe in myself.
You have already been your own support. You just, perhaps, didn't notice it...

17.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
17.descriptions:
Acknowledge that time belongs to me.
You are no longer obligated to live by externally imposed rhythms. This is your time...

18.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
18.descriptions:
Acknowledge fatigue.
You can be strong. For a long time. But sometimes the bravest step is to stop...

19.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
19.descriptions:
Restore freedom to the body.
Your body is not guilty. It is not obligated. It should not meet expectations...

20.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
20.descriptions:
Say “NO”.
It doesn't mean becoming rigid. It means – protecting. Your body. Your time. Your space...

21.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
21.descriptions:
Finish the unfinished.
Some stories have been open for too long. They prevent you from moving...

22.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
22.descriptions:
Cope with the wave.
Sometimes it hits. Suddenly. Without warning. But you – are not the wave. You are the shore...

23.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
23.descriptions:
Feel grounded in the body.
The body remembers even what the mind has forgotten. And when everything is shaky, it can become your earth...

24.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
24.descriptions:
Stay in my truth.
Even when it's uncomfortable for others. Even when the fear of losing connection arises...

25.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
25.descriptions:
Name what is.
When everything inside is shifting – words give form...

26.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
26.descriptions:
Choose my own pace.
You can slow down. And you can speed up. But only when you feel: this is my tempo...

27.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
27.descriptions:
Hear myself.
Sometimes we think so loudly that we forget to listen...

28.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
28.descriptions:
Stay in touch with myself.
The world is noisy. People pull. Circumstances demand. But there is a place inside you where it is quiet...

29.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
29.descriptions:
Clear space.
Letting go is not a loss, it's an invitation to the new. You have the right to do this.

30.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
30.descriptions:
Let go of control.
Are you tired of keeping everything under control? What if you allowed yourself to loosen your grip a bit...

31.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
31.descriptions:
Give a name to feelings.
What is unnamed lives in the shadows and often controls you, even if you don't realize it...

32.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
32.descriptions:
Let in changes.
Changes don't always bang on the door. Sometimes they stand quietly to the side, waiting for permission...

33.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
33.descriptions:
Feel the boundary between myself and others.
There is you and there are others. And this difference is not a threat. It's a way to preserve yourself...

34.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
34.descriptions:
Accept support.
It happens that a hand has been extended for a long time. You were just looking the other way...

35.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
35.descriptions:
Find inner support.
You were looking for support in others. In words, in actions, in glances...

36.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
36.descriptions:
Choose a new response.
You used to react habitually. Automatically. But what if today – it's different...

37.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
37.descriptions:
Change perspective.
You've been looking at it for so long that you no longer see anything new...

38.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
38.descriptions:
Find balance.
Perhaps right now you will remember how easy it is to lose yourself when you want to keep up with everything...

39.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
39.descriptions:
Hear another person.
Perhaps someone nearby has been trying to say something important for a long time...

40.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
40.descriptions:
Accept difference.
Not everything has to be understandable, similar, or comfortable. People are different...

41.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
41.descriptions:
Allow myself pleasure.
You have a right to pleasant things. Not as a reward. Not after achievements. Simply because you are alive...

42.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
42.descriptions:
Stop.
How much longer can you run without knowing where? And how often did the answer appear at the wrong time...

43.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
43.descriptions:
See reality.
Not the one created by fears. And not the one covered up by hopes. But the real one...

44.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
44.descriptions:
Restore energy.
You gave a lot, and maybe didn't even notice how you lost a part of yourself...

45.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
45.descriptions:
Feel what truly hurts.
You are used to suppressing it. Switching attention. Pretending that 'everything is fine'...

46.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
46.descriptions:
React as I can.
You have the right not to know what to say. You have the right to be silent. To cry. To freeze...

47.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
47.descriptions:
Return to myself.
You might have drifted away. In tasks, in relationships, in attempts to be correct...

48.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
48.descriptions:
Trust who I am.
You've doubted so many times, and so often looked for external confirmation...

49.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
49.descriptions:
Be present with myself.
You were present for others. A lot. Sincerely. What if today is your turn?..

50.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
50.descriptions:
Choose differently.
You can. Even if you chose differently before. Even if it seems like it's too late...

51.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
51.descriptions:
Trust the process.
You don't need to know everything in advance. Sometimes the answer only comes when you stop seeking it with tension...

52.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
52.descriptions:
Endure the silence.
Silence can be frightening. It seems like emptiness. But it is in the silence that meaning is born...

53.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
53.descriptions:
Feel the earth beneath my feet.
When thoughts are flying, when everything is shaky – remember your feet...

54.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
54.descriptions:
Feel myself in my body.
Your body is not just a shell. It is the space where you live...

55.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
55.descriptions:
Allow myself a pause.
You have the right not to be effective. Not to answer. Not to decide...

56.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
56.descriptions:
Give myself space.
You are used to narrowing yourself under circumstances, expectations, roles...

57.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
57.descriptions:
Leave myself in peace.
You have done enough. You analyzed. Corrected. But what if today you just let go?

58.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
58.descriptions:
Start from the beginning.
Start not from zero, but with experience. With a new sense of self.

59.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
59.descriptions:
Accept ambiguity.
The world is neither black nor white. Feelings are mixed. Choices are imperfect...

60.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
60.descriptions:
Be in the moment.
The past is over. The future has not yet arrived. But you are here. Right now...

61.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
61.descriptions:
Express the truth.
The truth is not always loud. And not always convenient. But it is yours...

62.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
62.descriptions:
Step out of the struggle.
You can fight all your life – for love, for a place, for the right to be. But what if enough is enough?

63.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
63.descriptions:
Feel what I truly want.
You have long lived by the desires of others. Expectations. Rules. What is your soul asking for?

64.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
64.descriptions:
Let in joy.
Joy is not always grand. Sometimes it's in the small things. In the sunrise, in a cup of tea, in silence...

65.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
65.descriptions:
Remember my right.
You have the right to be. You have the right to feel. You have the right to choose...

66.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
66.descriptions:
Heal the trauma.
You cannot ignore a wound, hoping it will disappear on its own. You need to work with it...

67.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
67.descriptions:
Accept what is.
Sometimes the fastest way forward is to stop fighting reality. Acknowledge that this is the way it is...

68.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
68.descriptions:
Create a ritual.
Rituals provide a sense of security and structure. This is your anchor in a turbulent world...

69.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
69.descriptions:
Allow myself to be imperfect.
Imperfection is not a flaw. It is a living space for growth...

70.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
70.descriptions:
Remember the value of time.
Your time is your life. You have the right to spend it on what is truly important...

71.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
71.descriptions:
Restore connection.
You might have lost connection with what you love, with those who love you...

72.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
72.descriptions:
Take care of myself.
You are your most important resource. And if it's depleted, then what's next?..

73.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
73.descriptions:
Recognize my path.
You don't have to follow everyone. Your destiny is unique.

74.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
74.descriptions:
Feel the inner silence.
Silence is not emptiness. It is the space where you hear your true voice.

75.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
75.descriptions:
Trust my intuition.
Your inner knowledge is the most accurate compass. Learn to hear it.

76.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
76.descriptions:
Take responsibility.
Not for everything. But only for your decisions, your feelings, your actions.

77.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
77.descriptions:
Find my strength.
It has always been with you. Perhaps it was just hidden under fear.

78.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
78.descriptions:
Make a choice.
There is no right or wrong. There is what moves you forward, and what holds you back.

79.name: Right now, it's important for me to...
79.descriptions:
See the meaning.
Even when everything around seems like chaos, you can find the thread that leads to the light.

1.name: Penetration into the essence of things. More than depth. Clear peace
1.descriptions:
Groundedness.
Stability, peace, and self-confidence.
Deep knowledge of all processes.
Observation of life events from silence.
Action based on impulse.

2.name: Initiation into Womanhood. Talents and Gifts. Inner confidence and core
2.descriptions:
Transmission of knowledge.
Attention and wisdom.
The laws of the universe in the palm of your hand.
Generosity and relaxation.
Transmission.
Transition to a new level thanks to the participation of the teacher-guide's personality.
Initiation.

3.name: Gentle approach to everything. Carefulness towards self and the World. Fluidity and smoothness
3.descriptions:
I charge my water with words of love and thoughts of kindness.
I manage the 'day' with attention to details and 'swim' towards my goals, gently, with anticipation and pleasure, moving towards them, making inconspicuous but constant efforts.

4.name: The joy of being in a pair. Enjoyment of the joint dance
4.descriptions:
Vivid emotions of the present moment!
You are here!
You simply exist - this is survival!
To bathe in this ocean of happiness!
To fly on the wings of inspiration and faith.
To thank the Universe endlessly.
To rejoice endlessly, seeing an embodied particle of God in the Beloved!!!

5.name: Fulfillment of external obligations and following the heart's call. Duty is God. Fulfillment of responsibilities is a sacred ritual
5.descriptions:
Every action can be turned into a sacred act, internally dedicated to the Higher Self.
Even the most boring work becomes an act of Love and immersion in mindfulness if it is performed with attention and love.
Our everyday duties are an opportunity to serve this World.
Love and training of consciousness.

6.name: Freedom from prejudice. Choosing internal authorities
6.descriptions:
The Great Call of the soul.
The ability to discard and recognize everything that hinders the Path.
To hear hints.
To move by signs.
To act from response.
To choose freedom and uncertainty.
To conquer with faith.

7.name: Family hierarchy: earthly and heavenly. Fulfillment of duty
7.descriptions:
Every family member has their roles.
To be in their place.
To respect the elders.
To know boundaries.
To feel measure.
To rejoice in moments spent together.
To remember that the heavenly is a projection of the earthly.

8.name: Reaching a New Level. Courage
8.descriptions:
Asking yourself questions is the basis of movement on the Path.
Courage to hear the answer.
What does my heart want?
Am I ready for changes?
What beautiful things can I do for the people around me and for all humanity?
How to become even more loving?
How to help the body be healthy and strong?
By asking questions, observe the birth of answers inside and even outside.

9.name: Love, present in everything. Granting abundance
9.descriptions:
Everything is moved by You, Love!
You are the source of well-being.
You are the Cause of the unconditional internal and external.
You give strength and inspiration for accomplishment!
Your support is priceless.

10.name: Multitasking. Vibrancy and fullness of every life cycle. Confidence in the correctness of the choice made
10.descriptions:
Manifestation and success in different areas of life.
Skillful switching from one activity to another.
From rest to intense load.
Correct application of advantages and skillful dedication of them to God.
Act bravely in decision-making.
Be generous and supportive.
Success in all endeavors.
Productivity and a series of internal and external victories.

11.name: Trust in what is happening. Everything is for the good. Stopping to reboot the systems
11.descriptions:
Sometimes immobility is a gift.
Simply being without entertaining communication, hustle, or deeds.
Just breathe, dream, reflect, plan a prayer of thanks.
Disconnect from the world to consciously channel the messages of the Spirit through yourself.

12.name: Abundance. Allowance. The ability to adequately assess and act consciously
12.descriptions:
Wherever you look - there are gifts and opportunities everywhere.
Open up to this ocean!
Surrender to the beauty of the Event Stream!
Everything is for you!
By the right of your birth.
Vibrant colors of life.

13.name: Greatness and awareness of one's Mission on Earth. Connection with the Whole
13.descriptions:
All great Souls stand behind me if I have given my life to God.
I am never alone.
The wisdom of the ages is with me.
The experience of humanity is with me.
Within me is a challenge to new horizons.
All necessary knowledge is already within me.
I give my love.
I radiate gratitude.

14.name: Commonality of interests and views. Unidirectional focus. Gracious company
14.descriptions:
The power of unity.
Multiple amplification of energies in joint movement.
Support of loved ones.
Collective work for the good of the World.
Seeing God in everyone and help from a pure heart.

15.name: To be a muse for the Creator. To be His life-giving spring
15.descriptions:
To nourish the Valuable with energy.
To fill the True with strength.
To be, not to seem.
To inspire with invisible emanations.

16.name: Healing energies. Health and purity
16.descriptions:
With purity of thoughts, I cleanse and heal myself and others.
I channel transformational flows through myself for healing on all levels.
I bravely go where it is scary.
I habitually give and thank.
I share generously.
My source is limitless.
The desire to help, to serve guides me.

17.name: Acquaintance with the world of wonders. Small - in the big, big - in the small
17.descriptions:
Stop and receive the gift of inner silence.
God speaks through beauty.
Find time to become a small child again.
With wide-open eyes.
Who is in loving, invisible embraces and is in no hurry.
To be with oneself.
To be saturated with beauty.
To see it everywhere.

18.name: Mistress of life. Order in everything. Structure. Inner core
18.descriptions:
Building, planning life processes.
Delegation - action through others.
Invisible management of flows.
Adherence to the logic of all processes.
Royal demeanor.
Responsibility for others.
Calmness and support for the entire environment.

19.name: Enthusiasm. Immersion in the process
19.descriptions:
The wave carries me, and I don't even have time to think and doubt.
Everything happens by itself.
I act, forgetting about myself.
I am totally immersed in the process and thrive in this game.
There is everyone and there is no me.
Happiness to be in the moment.
Fullness of life.

20.name: Greatness, modesty. Power is aimed at serving people. Grace and Compassion
20.descriptions:
Opportunity to serve.
Using resources for the common good.
Blessing of deeds.
The more you do for the world, the more your heart is filled with love and gratitude.
Vision of the Divine in every creature.
Health on all levels.

21.name: Revelation. New outlook. Freshness of feelings
21.descriptions:
Always new joy.
Experience life, as if for the first time.
Surprise.
Allowing masks to hide fragility and sound with the highest notes.
Mystery.

22.name: Nourishing the invisible roots with the energies of the Earth. Natural support
22.descriptions:
Physical and mental connection with Nature.
Entering meditative trance states by contemplating blossoming life.
Personal corners of power in nature.
Natural sources of strength for everyone.
Experiencing Unity with the whole world.
From trance, influencing the events and realities of one's life.

23.name: Creativity of life. Multifaceted magic of creation from a dream. Filling reality with colorful details
23.descriptions:
Notice the magic everywhere.
Be a magician in a world full of wonders.
This is the choice of the soul – this is reality.
Being on Paradise planets here, on Earth, thanks to the absence of jealousy, separation, envy.
Joy for the success of others.
Weaving lace.

24.name: Your strength is in your ability to admit your weakness. Strength is in trusting that all your prayers are always heard and supported
24.descriptions:
Admit your imperfection - unawareness, ignorance, inability - and gain powerful support from the entire Universe!
The Divine Mother is embodied in every earthly woman.
Inner and outer reverence.
Nature, as a manifestation of the Goddess.
Communication with her is an opportunity to be nourished and grow beyond yourself.

25.name: Beauty of events. Timeliness. Givenness. Responsibility for the creation of one's reality through faith, thoughts, vibrations
25.descriptions:
Everything has its appointed time.
Fulfillment of agreements.
Unexpected joy.
Admission of one's ignorance in many areas of life.
Surrender oneself to the higher flow!
To the Guide.
Absence of worries and anxieties.

26.name: I am a child in the Divine hands. I am so safe and warm
26.descriptions:
We constantly play tricks in life, but the Divine Mother never stops nurturing and caring for us, no matter what we do.
Her love forgives endlessly.
She believes in every one of her children, keeps the initially written and embedded to manifest at the right time.
She knows this time, and patiently, with love, awaits our awakening.

27.name: Care for everyone is born from an overflowing, healed heart, capable of giving generously
27.descriptions:
Giving in love without expectations will never bring fatigue.
It is one, you will not diminish it.
Everyone is a Source of love and happiness.
Discover this spring.
Fill yourself and be an inspiration to others.
Grace, manifested on all levels of matter, thoughts, and feelings.
Materialization and realization of all intentions and needs for the good of all.

28.name: Safe journeys. Enjoyment of the road
28.descriptions:
The new opens gradually, and boundless options unfold unhurriedly.
Manage large processes with ease.
Move towards the unknown, trusting the inner impulse.
Know that you are being led.
Enjoying, letting go of thoughts about the result.
Carry the tidings of Goodness everywhere.

29.name: Goodness in communication. Good thoughts. Deeds full of kindness
29.descriptions:
I know you.
You know me.
Friendliness and acceptance.
Kindness on the level of thoughts, words, and deeds.
Talk to people only about the good, and do not talk about others in their presence at all.
To be connected by the same tasks and motives.
Amplify the collective creative Flow together.

30.name: Sisterhood. Joint action in harmony
30.descriptions:
Understanding with a half-word.
Resonance and harmonious complement.
Trust in the leader and the collective, acceptance and fulfillment of one's role as best as possible.
Being on both sides of the reaction and through music.
Synchronization of life processes.
The joy of co-creation.

31.name: Shining Femininity. Attractiveness. Motherhood, as part of the Path and female realization
31.descriptions:
Awareness and acceptance of one's natural beauty.
Following the inner voice, clear vision of one's Path.
Realization in all spheres of life, especially those related to children or creativity.

32.name: Bearing the Treasure within
32.descriptions:
You protect creation with your state.
You fill it with goodness and grace.
This is what protection is.
Fragile, you possess great power.
All are your children.
I feel your Love within.
Manifest through me!

33.name: Success in deeds. Heavenly patronage
33.descriptions:
We will go where others retreat, for the wings of the Seraphim are with us.
We sail past fatal danger, and therefore fate no longer controls us.
We know who is guiding us, and therefore we are stronger than any circumstances.
We are always in touch with our Guardians.

34.name: Givenness. Acceptance. Peace
34.descriptions:
Active actions outside and stillness within.
External inaction and active inner work.
Everything in life is about Balance.
Any stop leads to a fall.
Constant spiritual aspiration.
Action without the one who acts.

35.name: Joint intention. Bringing the conceived into reality thanks to the power of Love
35.descriptions:
Magic and wonder beyond the perception of the mind.
Co-creation with God!
Victory over the fear of the unknown.
A beautiful dance, so captivating, so playful!
The whole world dances and rejoices with us.
We are on the Peak of the World!
We are one with the Universe.

36.name: Time to bloom. Time to fragrance. Time to enjoy oneself and life!
36.descriptions:
I am already beautiful and accept myself Whole.
I value my peculiarities and their strangeness as unique gifts.
And I live my role with dignity.
I take everything from this world, I share boundless gratitude with the World and feel its love.

37.name: Touch of magic. Life in a fairy tale
37.descriptions:
The truth is that we already live in a Fairy Tale, in our dream, which we constantly correct with our thoughts and feelings.
The beauty and abundance of reality adjusts to our wishes...
Anticipation of miracles.

38.name: Heartfelt repentance. Magnanimity and mercy. Non-judgment
38.descriptions:
Shifting attention from the external to the internal.
Transforming oneself through compassion for all living beings.
Boundless source of Love.
True faith through healing the soul's wounds.
Contrition and letting go of everything done and undone.
Peace and surrender to God.

39.name: Simplicity and balance. From complex to simple
39.descriptions:
The long-awaited meeting happens in clarity.
A new movement is born in wholeness.
And everything is in its place!
Again.
For the good of all!
To the glory of God!
Remember: where there are too many questions, doubts, a lot of energy flows away.
Where it is simple and clear, the Truth blossoms.

40.name: Unwavering peace and inner self-worth. Respecting oneself and one's boundaries
40.descriptions:
Acknowledging one's role as maximally beautiful.
It is impossible and unnecessary to compare oneself with anything.
The inherent value of every being.
Self-knowledge and fulfilling one's mission is defeated by self-acceptance and condemnation.
Victory over pettiness.
Large-scale thinking.

41.name: Dreams of the Beautiful. Reflections. Transformational Keys
41.descriptions: To view the world through peaceful contemplation. To find time for solitude and self-acquaintance. The sweetness of life in the small things and the thought of how blessings will serve as what is realized from what is embedded there. Reprogramming. A conscious encounter with one's destructive programs and their complete transformation through the energy of grace.

42.name: Vibration. Healing Sound. Conscious Formation of Images and States
42.descriptions: Every word carries a vibration that influences our lives. To liberate oneself through sound and transform reality. To express oneself to the world through voice. To enjoy melodic speech in every moment of communication and grace.

43.name: Conscious Creation of Reality through Thought-Forms and States. Devotion to Higher Ideals. Concentration on the Divine
43.descriptions: The vibration of White Light. Belief in the Truth and serving it on the level of thoughts as continuous remembrance of the Divine. Abiding in Him. Conversation with Him. We nourish ourselves, we create ourselves, we discern various thought-forms. What they are, what we are. We create ourselves in unity. Divine success, beauty, health, love, trust, by ceasing to feed thoughts about everyday trifles and worries.

44.name: The Value of Each. Inner Radiance
44.descriptions: To see the true essence of things through the forms and pictures of what is happening. To concentrate on the most sacred. Only to think, speak, and listen about it. Inner harmony. To avoid vanity and celebrations, choosing solemn solitude.

45.name: Royal Union. Total Acceptance without the Desire to Redo. Faith in a Loved One
45.descriptions: Wholehearted acceptance of life, a person, or a situation with all its facets, especially those that contradict interests. Filling with meaning. Finding the positives in all of life's vicissitudes. The triumph of balance.

46.name: Knowledge Across Distance. Prayer for All Sufferers. Attention to the Great and the Small
46.descriptions: To give oneself entirely. Who are you and how do you serve? True heart. Genuine concern, compassion, and mercy. Equal service to all unconditionally, selfless fulfillment of the Call of one's heart. Forgetting oneself.

47.name: The Greatness of Woman. Manifested Matter. The Power of Loving Beauty
47.descriptions: You disarm. At your feet are all the treasures and riches of the World. You are multifaceted good. Transformations begin next to you. Ideas and inspiration overflow! You are in our cell. Possessed by the Spirit! You are Life itself and its ceaseless development.

48.name: Unconditional Love only gives, expecting nothing in return. In it – only joy, only a bright perception of reality
48.descriptions: Satisfaction and pure joy without desires for any benefit and expectation of receiving something in return. Giving without looking back, just so, without requests, without obligations. Out of love. Doing lovingly. Abiding in the rays of true love, not remembering oneself and not thinking about oneself too much.

49.name: Gazing into one's weaknesses. The resource of our Power is hidden there. What gifts do we not see and reject?
49.descriptions: The power of habit forces one to walk in the same circle, to desire the same vibrations. Through calming and humility to rise into the space of silence, reflection. Consciously surround oneself with thoughts and people of a higher order. Make efforts. Call for help. Forgive oneself, others. Continue the path.

50.name: Inspirer. Filled with peace, I bring harmony to the World
50.descriptions: I radiate thoughts of beauty into the World. They, in turn, create reality around me. Paradise on earth, and everyone has the opportunity to connect with my reality. I inspire by my own example and instill hope for an even more beautiful future, overflowing with gifts for this World. I am loved by love, which I generously share. The source of inner bliss feeds my thoughts, words, and deeds.

51.name: Fulfillment of Agreements. Accomplishment of the Planned at the Right Time
51.descriptions: We have waited for this moment and, finally, we can realize what was intended. We will pass through the walls of doubts and fears to realize our goal. To manifest the highest beauty of the Spirit in the world through earthly form. We are children of Love. We are the beloved of God. Our attitude is to conquer, playing and rejoicing!

52.name: Nature as a Teacher. The Magic of the Earth and the Guardian Spirits
52.descriptions: Find your place of power. Abide there, make friends with it. It will be willing to share much in response to unconditional love, softness, tenderness. The space will ring and heal all your bodies. Accept these resources and this knowledge with gratitude.

53.name: Learning New Things. Going Beyond, Uniting Figurative Thinking, Flow, and Logic
53.descriptions: Constantly growing beyond oneself. Surrounding oneself with new interests, impressions, travels. The Science of Imagery. What images do we transmit, what are we attracted by, and why? Asking questions. Expanding the boundaries of perception.

54.name: The Importance of Choosing Your Environment. Your Own Transformations Affect Those Nearby and Even Those Far Away
54.descriptions: An environment selected in accordance with inner ideals, values, and goals. Everyone encountered is a messenger, a teacher. Will he reflect you, tear your consciousness away, reach your demons, become a consolation and support, reveal you as the brightest, or will he be silenced forever? "God speaks". Listening to the World, not ceasing to hear the impulses of one's Heart. A desire for good and realization for all.

55.name: Nourishing Ideas. Germination of Habit-Seeds
55.descriptions: Our thoughts form a field of vibrations that influences our behavior and reactions. Here and now, we are forming our Path. Regular actions create habit programs. Which help or hinder on the Path. More important: why do I choose to do exactly this? Where is my attention and what am I nourishing now? Do I want these very thoughts to grow into a large tree? Where does the energy go?

56.name: Games of the Spirits. Another Reality. Rebirth
56.descriptions: Internal changes are inevitable. We are here to change our destiny. We can be reborn every second. How much we do not know about ourselves. Having united with our divine nature. Spirits come for this. A feeling of colossal harmony and boundless peace and satisfaction.

57.name: Healing Trance. State without Mind. Pure Consciousness and Self-Acceptance
57.descriptions: To abide beyond desires. To allow life to simply flow through you. To love easily, to love work, to love events, to love people. In everything, the Invisible is revealed. This is magic and Her dreams within us. Everyone possesses their own uniqueness. To recognize, accept, realize the value of their peculiarities: character, appearance, family.

58.name: Treasure of the Heavens. Perceiving everything that comes into life as a gift. The ability to see beauty in everything
58.descriptions: Celebrating life in its constant creativity! Enthusiasm for contemplating the beautiful. A careful, tender attitude toward everything living and non-living. Inner radiance. Dawn and realization. Absorbing all the beauty of the World. Joy from the variety of forms and manifestations.

59.name: Blessing and Pulsation of Life. Readiness. Fullness. Agreement of All Sides
59.descriptions: Life manifests from nothing. A miracle – the fruits of the Spirit's action on Earth. Maternal energy. Nourishing the fruit and the project. Concentration of energy in one place. Transformation and magic. The power of pure intentions.

60.name: Fertility and Productivity. Proper Use of Your Abilities. Self-Realization
60.descriptions: Fulfilling duty in clarity and purity. Directed attention and daily, constant work in joy. Heroism and satisfaction from both the process and the contemplation of the fruits of deeds. Fullness and generosity.

61.name: Reclaiming One's Energy. Untangling Karmic Knots. Victory over Outdated Beliefs
61.descriptions: Mutual Liberation. A sigh of relief and inner jubilation! Sincere gratitude to all participants of the game. Completion of debts. Only the inner Imperative remains. Anticipation of victory. Healing and delight. The right to a new life and change. Confidence in one's inner truth.

62.name: Clairaudience. Clairvoyance. Speaking from the Flow
62.descriptions: You know how to see. You know how to listen. You know how to speak in such a way that it will be remembered for a lifetime and beyond. Who are you and where does this knowledge come from within you? Awaken them in me! Resurrect my memory! Return the primordial, divine nature to the world! From now on and forever, I possess full knowledge so that everything around me flourishes!!!

63.name: Nourishing Each Other with Faith and Knowledge. Admiring the Beloved
63.descriptions: Knowing God in the other. Touching the Divine with reverence every day. Nourishment. Delight. Admiring the "beauty" of the World by the Beloved, manifested on Earth! Tasting the Truth. Enjoying the gifts. Penetrating into the depths. Understanding the world of the other.

64.name: Heavenly Secrets. Falling in Love with the Spirit. Acquiring Gifts
64.descriptions: Sacred friendship. The soul's desire with all its being to realize the intention of its Spirit on Earth. Sensitive attention to the inner voice and the plans of the Gods on the Path. Keeping one's plans and ideas secret for a while. Nourishing them with one's energy and attention.

65.name: Revitalization of the Everyday. Celebration. Realization. Unpacking Gifts
65.descriptions: We look to the future boldly, without fear. We color the future with our inner anticipation of miracles! The Child and the Eternal inner Mentor enjoy each other's company, not pulling in their own direction. Only together, relying on discipline, order, schedule, regularity on one side, and on spontaneity, creativity, improvisation on the other, do we transform reality into a festival-extravaganza!

66.name: Beginning and End. Perfection of the Game
66.descriptions: To find pleasure in simple actions. To live every day in the joy of work. To find something to be grateful for in every moment and phenomenon. To be a source of positive vibrations for others. To live, playing! In tireless creativity and fulfillment of duty.

67.name: Life on High Vibrations. Living True Values in Life. Moving into the Depth. Trust
67.descriptions: Only from a state of fullness and self-sufficiency can we share. Creativity of inner Love. We transmit it to the World. Absence of unrealized desires. Inner satisfaction from everything that is happening. Acceptance of everything with gratitude.

68.name: Fortitude and Confidence in One's Victory. Who, if not I? This Moment is Ideal!
68.descriptions: Acquisition of inner strength. Setting the mind for change and self-improvement. Controlling resources. Precisely set vector of movement.

69.name: Gentle Acceptance of the New Without Denial. Giving Oneself Time. The Breath of the Clan (Rod). Manifestation
69.descriptions: Everything replaces everything else. To be a conductor for different processes and energies. To invite a new life. To accept gently, to preserve, not to rush. To allow processes to happen naturally. To learn, acquire knowledge, and apply it. To accept new energies with respect.

70.name: Vulnerability and Subtlety. Sweetness and Tenderness. Care for the Inner Child
70.descriptions: To guard and value the sacred. To dwell in an inner happiness and carelessness that is independent of anything. Directed rays of love. Support and caring attitude towards children. Shine of kindness. Blessed work of the educator.

71.name: Immersion in exciting life Flows! Shocking delight! Diving into the abyss of possibilities. Power
71.descriptions: Courage is to contribute with the entire Universe! We will go into this process boldly and devotedly. We transform pain into grace. We heal past traumas, acknowledging them and not being afraid to break the boundaries. We suppress doubts with our faith in the best! We nourish our strength, not weakness. We are warriors of Light!!!

72.name: Manifestation of Beauty into the World. Art that unites everyone. Harmonizing creativity
72.descriptions: In the union of different elements and the collaboration of energies, beauty is born. Observing miracles on the fingertips. Listening to the voices of the elements. Uniting opposites to create something unique. Connecting the unconnected for the greater good.

73.name: Determination to heal, to free oneself from the obsolete and burdensome. Healing. Playful Shamanism
73.descriptions: Penetration into the essence of the problem physically and at the level of the mind, and its decisive elimination. Resorting to the help of the knowledgeable. Trust and surrender in gratitude. Mentorship. The power of providence. To be in the right place at the right time.

74.name: Inner sun. Letting go of intention. Relaxation
74.descriptions: I have done everything possible, and now all that remains is to trust what is happening. To breathe deeply. To feel the warmth.

75.name: Tuning into God's wave. Even a single thought of God immerses one in the Bliss of His invisible Presence
75.descriptions: Just freeze. His name, and His Face, sounds in every moment, and His Face is in everything. Abide in Him, contemplating the most beautiful thing a person can experience on Earth, but it is also the result of spiritual efforts, the striving of the soul, and concentration. Sincere efforts will always be heard.

76.name: Tender Love of the Mother and Forgiveness. Pure joy and a childlike, carefree perception
76.descriptions: Someone is invisibly always near. I trust providence. Invisible helpers support me in every new exam on earth. I am never alone. They nourish me, they always support me. I know that the mighty power of love protects me.

77.name: Transition. Calling for help. Mother's Support
77.descriptions: We need a guide. We need protection in this raging ocean of passions. You are the Mother, our protection! Reveal Your Face! Manifest Yourself, so that we may fully know You, and not be able to doubt. You are all our Life. Your invisible presence makes our Path bright and joyful!

78.name: Protective power of love. Prayer for loved ones. Patronage of the Higher Forces in travel
78.descriptions: Wherever your Paths may lead you, my love is with you everywhere. It will guide you and give you knowledge and peace in the most difficult situations. For this love, there are no distances. It knows all your thoughts and heart's intentions. No enemy will break through, no element will overtake.

79.name: Self-Understanding. Choosing Priorities
79.descriptions: The nature of the soul is divine and pure. The crystal surface of the water. Birds soaring into the sky—this is our beautiful essence. Conscious construction of the Path. Breadth of vision and simplicity.

80.name: When you love – you are protected. Faith strengthens knowledge. Knowledge strengthens faith
80.descriptions: To feel Peace from the invisible presence of the Holy Spirit. You are where you should be, and the Universe will guide and turn you into the ocean of life according to the best possible scenario. Don't worry about anything, just do your thing. Become aware of existence through meditation and dedicate vibrations through prayer. Trust. Accept. Let it flow.
